title: Research: exclude pure native T740 repair with global charts
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The T740 owner0/port0 transfer `child10 -> child12, axis16` lowers the concave recursive child bill (`48,48 -> 47,49`) but changes the operator. This source-bound proof tests one-site absorption through reciprocal linear charts that may mix every address, stream and arbitrary dirty spectator restored at exit.

All twenty cuts fail similarity to one **pure native tensor phase** on active volume `N=2^73`, even granting any rank 0–73, either direction, any nonzero scalar and free new implementation costs. The required squared trace is 5N at six sites and 6N at fourteen; every positive-rank native tensor requires 7N. The first trace also excludes rank-zero scalar phases. Complete symbolic address sums establish those finite invariants; the written conjugacy argument covers arbitrary charts and restored spectator dimension.

Original separate translations stay fixed. Added address-dependent phases such as `iZ_v`, nonreciprocal adapters, joint rewrites and increased active volume remain outside scope. No supplier, selected-frontier change or new kappa is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Task `complex-new-helper-inventory`, **changed scope**: Discussion1167 assigns a changed recursive-cost interface; this closes the pure-native-child/global-chart obligation rather than searching a new helper inventory. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-19004295).

Base `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, priority 6, unchanged at the 21:19:58 UTC refresh. [SOURCES.json](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/45f5aec228cacc6d31a31e3bbc23fc32fd2584c8/research/idle-global-chart-similarity/SOURCES.json) pins every runtime source to canonical ancestry, PR3148's allocation lineage, and PR3275's exact cited head `74d54090585e4b2c6d648be30f4ac0e8e4466c67`.

PR3254 permits fixed scalar stream charts; PR3275 permits character-dependent charts and arbitrary middle eigenvalue functions while keeping characters separate. This result permits global mixing but requires a pure native middle tensor, so the PR3275 domains are incomparable. Arham Tahir's related uniform tensor-lane trace classification is credited; the new calculation concerns the nonuniform required T740 cut operators.

Submission overlap fully paginates 348 open PRs including drafts, 2630 closed/merged PRs and 2147 Discussion records at 21:20:05–21:21:28 UTC, without warnings. Text/metadata and local-ledger coverage omit arbitrary diffs and unpublished work.

## Validation

At `45f5aec228cacc6d31a31e3bbc23fc32fd2584c8`:

- Registered CPython 3.12 replay passes with both optimized exact checkers. They authenticate all 2,717,280 fill rows, establish the complete symbolic baseline and twenty full cut operators; the primary also checks 200 finite literal cuts at ten characters.
- Both optimized CPython 3.14 checkers pass from the committed read-only Git-free export. All 30 publication/input files and 31 export files including its manifest verify. Three final source-bound local checkpoint stages executed fresh. The export includes the inherited loader's actual selected-record/catalogue reads.
- Separate phase representations, quadratic elimination and direct connected-component enumeration agree. Each quadratic oracle checks all 549 forms through three bits and 15 four-bit parity forms. Successful cross-character conjugacy, rank-zero active-i phase, expanded `iZ_v` spectral boundary, omitted translation, bridge sign and inverse-order controls distinguish the scope.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/idle-global-chart-similarity
```

Hosted CI and maintainer review are separate from local validation. The eight-stream completed-child projection remains inherited; full native/supplier cold replay, physical adapter tariffs, all-size implications and formal-kernel verification are unrun.
